text: Hey guys! My TikTok channel is officially one year old. I uploaded my first video on this channel at the end of July 2025 and it has been an incredible journey since then. Could I have imagined that the channel would grow to more than 400,000 followers and reach 105 million views in such a short time? I definitely hoped for it, but it was still very difficult to imagine, especially considering that I was doing all of this as a hobby next to my full-time job. My Instagram has also reached 50,000 followers and most importantly, my YouTube channel has finally surpassed 1,000 subscribers. Seriously, go and subscribe to my YouTube channel. It's a little embarrassing. You can find the links in my bio. When I started the channel, my original goal was simply to make videos about men's issues, dating, relationships, and personal growth. But TikTok apparently had its own plans for me. Somehow, the algorithm pushed me towards debate, fact-checking viral claims, and discussing broader issues that affect both men and women. Well, I guess I cannot complain. It worked and here we are. Of course, there have also been some difficulties along the way. A copyright strike, alleged shadow bans, and TikTok not exactly being willing to pay fairly for my views. The last part is still an issue. So, as always, one of the best ways to support the channel is by becoming a paid subscriber. You get access to exclusive content, the members' chat, and priority DMs with me. But most importantly, I want to say thank you. Thank you to the people who have been here since the beginning and to those who discovered the channel only recently. Thank you to everyone who watches my videos, leaves comments, likes and shares them, joins my live streams, donates through TikTok or Ko-Fi, or sends me messages and words of support. Thank you to the other content creators who supported me, debated me, reacted to my videos, or simply reached out to me. And even thank you to the haters who leave nasty comments and send me angry messages. I guess you cannot really have one without the other. At the very least, you are helping with the engagement. So a big thank you to all of you. Without you, this first year would not have been the same. Hopefully, this is only the beginning, and there is much more good content to come. My main goal for the second year is to monetize content creation sufficiently and eventually switch to doing it full-time. In terms of numbers, the next target is 500,000 followers, and after that, 1 million. And of course, I want to continue making content that you guys actually find interesting and useful. Let's see what we can achieve in year 2. My name is Ilyas Abdullin and thank you.
